morphology.pattern_note: 词根无词缀。meN- + lipat → melipat：在 /l/ 前采用 me-，保留 l；lipat + -an → lipatan，词根末尾 t 保留。

senses.zh_definition: 将物体弯折而不断开，使部分相互重叠所形成的折层或折叠结构。
senses.en_definition: A fold formed by bending something over without breaking it.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian sesuatu yang dibengkokkan tanpa putus sehingga berlapis; lepit.
senses.nuances: 对应 DBP 的基本名词义。独立表示“折层、折叠处”时常用 lipatan；lipat 常见于复合词。爪夷文和音节严格保留资料包形式。[DBP：lipat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=lipat)

senses.zh_definition: 重叠成若干重的；成倍的。
senses.en_definition: Fold or multiple, indicating repeated layers or multiplication.
senses.nuances: 对应 DBP 的 ganda、rangkap 义。这里以 adjective 近似表示性质或倍数功能；berlipat ganda 表示成倍增长，不必然限定为恰好两倍。[DBP：lipat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=lipat)

collocations.zh: 双重；两倍，或依动作语境指对折
collocations.en: double; folded in two, depending on context

senses.zh_definition: 把纸张、布料等弯折，使一部分覆盖另一部分；折叠。
senses.en_definition: To bend one part of something over another; to fold.
senses.ms_definition: Membengkokkan sesuatu supaya bahagiannya bertangkup atau berlapis.
senses.nuances: 词根动词常见于命令句和口语；正式主动陈述一般用 melipat，如 Saya melipat baju。这里不把派生词 melipat 的全部比喻义自动列为裸词根的常用义。[DBP：lipat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=lipat)

dual_scenarios.context: 表格填写指引 / 办公室通知
dual_scenarios.ms: Sila lipat borang ini kepada dua bahagian sebelum memasukkannya ke dalam sampul surat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 请将这份表格对折后再放入信封。
dual_scenarios.en: Please fold this form in half before placing it in the envelope.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Baju dah kering. Tolong lipat dulu ya.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Baju sudah kering. Tolong lipat baju itu dahulu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 衣服干了，先帮忙叠一下哦。
dual_scenarios.en: The clothes are dry. Please fold them first, okay?
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式
ya 使请求语气较柔和

messages.ms_spoken: Baju dah kering. Tolong lipat dulu ya.
messages.ms_standard: Baju sudah kering. Tolong lipat baju itu dahulu.
messages.zh: 衣服干了，先帮忙叠一下哦。
messages.en: The clothes are dry. Please fold them first, okay?

messages.speaker: Hakim (弟弟)
messages.ms_spoken: Okey, nanti aku lipat. Letak kat sofa je dulu.
messages.ms_standard: Baiklah, nanti saya akan melipatnya. Letakkan baju itu di atas sofa dahulu.
messages.zh: 好，我待会儿叠。先放沙发上就行。
messages.en: Okay, I'll fold them in a bit. Just leave them on the sofa for now.

etymology.historical_story: Lipat is an established Malay root connecting the physical act of folding with the idea of repeated layers or multiples. DBP records both meanings and derivatives such as melipat and lipatan. The connection offers a useful cultural image: folding cloth creates layers, while figurative multiplication creates greater quantities. A specific ancient origin is not established by the supplied evidence. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=lipat)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 li.pat 拍两下：第一拍拿起纸边，第二拍压下折好。由“折出多层”联想到“成倍”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: Lipat! 是直接命令。向不熟悉的人、长辈或客户提出请求时，可说 Tolong lipat… 或 Sila lipat…。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于衣物、纸张和可折叠物品。表示普通折叠用 melipat；若强调压出折痕、卷起或揉皱，应分别考虑其他更准确的动词。
